message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: employee (security guard) stole chips from company, value 359,076 RMB, sold for 59,000 (but value is high). This is theft (盗窃). Any other crimes? Possibly "职务侵占" (embezzlement) because he was a security guard with duty to receive goods, but he stole. In Chinese criminal law, theft (盗窃罪) applies when taking property of others by stealth, etc. He used his position to take. Could also be "职务侵占罪" if he was entrusted with property in his job. However typical classification: security guard taking company property is theft, not embezzlement, because he didn't have legal custody? He was responsible for receiving and signing for goods, so he had custody. Embezzlement (职务侵占) is for persons in charge of public or private property, who appropriate it. The examples: In earlier example, theft of electric bikes was theft. The case of stealing chips is similar to theft. So answer: 盗窃.

Check if any other crimes like "非法持有" no. "诈骗" no. So single crime.

Thus output JSON with reasoning and final answer.
